title: Hassan Raza Di Maiyat Te Teeran Diyan Hoiyan Chawan
body:
Jadon Pak Janaza Veeran Da Haye Chaya Aan Bhirawan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kadi Maaran Vajan Haye Nanay Nun Qadi Dain Sadawan Babay Nu
Kalsoum Zainab Ne Jadh Dhitiyan Veeran Diyan Tutdiyan Sawan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasim Diyan Phupiyan Mar Jan Gaiyan Ay Soch Ke Farwa Ne Puchiya
Main Hasan De Dil Day Tukrayian Nun Bhena Tun Keevain Lukawan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zahra Diya Jaiyan Pardh Nad-e-Ali Chikhay Teer Veeran Di Maiyat Chon
Karbal Day Aan Ton Pehlan Hi Paiyan Rondiyaan Baaj Ridawan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab Zahra Nun Eh Kehndi Si Aj Baqiya Chor Ke Aa Mayin
Haye Khoon Aloodha Kafan De Vich Tere Putar Di Maiyat Vakhawan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Najaf De Passay Zainab Ujhri Ro Ro Ke Piyo Ton Puchdi Si
Dus Veer Hasan Di Pagh Baba Qasim Nun Kinjh Pehnawan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Akhtar Piya Momin Taboot Uthay Mola Ton Ro Ro Mangday Nay
Mazloom Hassan De Sadqay Vi Sub Pooriya Hon Duawan.
